radio.description: One world. One human family. Listen to the shared frequency of humanity.
radio.shared_desc: Music, voices, stories and conversations from across the Echoes community — gathered into one continuous global listening space.
radio.voices_desc: A living radio space where music, human stories, thoughtful conversation and voices from across the world can meet.
radio.music_desc: Original works and selected music shaped around dignity, belonging, hope and our shared humanity.
radio.conversations_desc: Human conversations that cross borders, cultures and generations without losing the intimacy of a single voice.
radio.podcasts_desc: Stories, ideas and documentary listening created across the Echoes Global Media Network.
radio.live_desc: Live voices, special broadcasts and shared moments from the global Echoes community.
radio.schedule_title: A Radio That Moves With the World
radio.schedule_desc: Echoes Radio is designed for a continuous global schedule. Music, conversations, podcasts, stories and live broadcasts will move through one shared programming flow while remaining identifiable as distinct programs.
radio.now_desc: The current broadcast will appear here with its program title, format and live status.
radio.next_desc: The next scheduled program will be visible before it begins so listeners can stay with the shared frequency.
radio.flow_desc: When no live program is on air, scheduled and approved Echoes audio can keep the station alive without breaking the broadcast experience.
